question: The four metrics are four separate Kaggle competitions and the kit's submitter has an --only flag, so a different file could in principle be sent to each board, per-clip optimised for that metric. On Tier 1 that would even be legal to decide on truth, because the permitted input IS the configured scoring reference. Is it worth anything?
method: For all 30 clips, took the best rollout per metric across every Tier 1 tree on disk: the wave-2 ships, the 23 warm-start fine-tunes, and the 30-clip cold-swap clean-input eval.
why_it_is_empty: The seven clips sitting 0.85-2.15 cm from the MP-SR gate have no rollout in any tree that crosses it -- their fine-tunes all made MPPE worse (e02 4.57 -> 35.05 cm, e21 4.79 -> 10.34, e29 3.85 -> 8.72) and the cold-swap arm is worse still. There is nothing to select; the centimetre has to be earned by a better policy.
conclusion: Keep one file per tier on all four of its boards, as the kit's submitter does by default. This also means the single-file discipline costs us nothing, so there is no judgement call to make about whether per-metric files would be within the spirit of the challenge.
